profile.name: 安捷伦E44xx频谱分析仪
profile.description: 这是一类用于测量射频和微波信号频谱的台式频谱分析仪，可对信号的频率分布、功率电平和带宽特性进行分析。实验中常用于信号源表征、杂散与谐波测试、带宽测量、频谱监测以及一般射频链路调试。
profile.description_en: This is a benchtop spectrum analyzer for measuring the spectral content of RF and microwave signals. It is commonly used in laboratories for signal source characterization, spurious and harmonic measurements, bandwidth analysis, spectrum monitoring, and general RF chain debugging.
